page.content:
The principal tribe of gods: Odin, Thor, Frigg, and their kin.

How Aesir connects

  • Character: Odin — Odin is chief of the Aesir.
  • Location: Asgard — Asgard is the fortified home of the Aesir.
  • Character: Thor — Thor is the Aesir thunderer who guards Midgard.
  • Character: Frigg — Frigg is Odin's wife among the Aesir.
  • Character: Baldur — Baldur is the shining son of the Aesir.
  • Character: Tyr — Tyr is the one-handed Aesir of law and war.
  • Character: Heimdall — Heimdall is the Aesir watchman of the bridge.
  • Faction: Vanir — The Vanir and Aesir made peace by exchanging hostages.

What is Aesir?

The Aesir are the warlike gods of Asgard. They warred with the Vanir, exchanged hostages, and remain the central divine household of the Eddas.

Key threads lead to Odin, Asgard, Thor, Frigg, Baldur and Tyr.
